fragments.text: Good morning everyone, and welcome to the Museum of Farming Life.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 大家早上好，欢迎来到农业生活博物馆。

fragments.text: I understand it's your first visit here, so I'd like to give you some
and then

acceptedAnswers: explain a little about what you can see during your visit

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 我知道这是你们第一次来这里，所以我想给你们一些关于博物馆的背景信息，并解释一下你们在参观期间可以看到的一些内容。

fragments.text: So, where we're standing at the moment is

acceptedAnswers: the entrance to a large building

fragments.text: that was
as the home of a local businessman, Alfred Palmer, of the Palmer biscuit factory.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 现在我们站的地方是一个大建筑的入口，这个建筑在1880年建成，是当地商人阿尔弗雷德·帕尔默的家，也是帕尔默饼干工厂的所在地。

fragments.text: It was later sold and became a
in 1911, and a museum in 1951. In 2005, a
was built to

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 后来它被出售并于1911年成为学生宿舍，1951年成为一座博物馆。在2005年，我们建造了一个现代化的扩建，用于展示博物馆的藏品。

fragments.text: The museum's owned by the university, and apart from two rooms that are our offices,

acceptedAnswers: the university uses the main part of the building

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 博物馆由大学所有，除了两个办公室外，大学使用建筑的主要部分。

fragments.text: You may see students going into the building for lessons, but it's not open to museum visitors, I'm afraid.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 你可能会看到学生进入建筑上课，但对于博物馆的参观者来说，建筑是不开放的，很遗憾。

fragments.text: It's a shame because the
especially the room that used to be the library.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 这是一种遗憾，因为室内的建筑特色非常出色，尤其是曾经是图书馆的那个房间。

fragments.text: Luckily, we've managed to keep entry to the museum

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 幸运的是，我们成功地保持了博物馆的免费入场。

fragments.text: This includes

acceptedAnswers: access to all the galleries, outdoor areas and the rooms for special exhibitions

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 这包括进入所有的展览馆、室外区域和特别展览的房间。

fragments.text: We
for children and students, such as the museum club, for which there's no charge.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 我们为儿童和学生开展活动，比如博物馆俱乐部，没有收费。

fragments.text: We do have a
just over there, so feel free to give whatever amount you consider appropriate.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 我们有一个捐款箱就在那边，所以请随意捐款，任何你认为合适的金额都可以。

fragments.text: We do have a
, if you'd like to leave your coats and bags somewhere.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 我们有一个衣帽间，如果你想把外套和包放在某个地方的话。

fragments.text: Unlike other museums,
so you might like to keep your
with you.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 与其他博物馆不同，这里允许拍照，所以你可以随身携带相机。

fragments.text: You might be more comfortable not carrying around heavy
, though keep your coats and jackets on as it's quite cold in the museum garden today.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 不过，你可能会觉得不用背着沉重的背包会更舒服，不过还是保持穿着外套，因为博物馆花园里今天相当冷。

fragments.text: I'd like to tell you about the different areas of the museum.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 我想告诉你们关于博物馆的不同区域。

fragments.text: Just inside, and outside the main gallery, we have an area called Four Seasons.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 就在入口内部和主展厅外面，有一个叫做四季的区域。

fragments.text: Here you can watch

acceptedAnswers: a four-minute animation of a woodland scene

fragments.text: . It was designed especially for the museum by a group of young people on
, and it's beautiful.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 在这里，你可以观看一个四分钟的动画木地板场景。这是由一组电影学专业的年轻人为博物馆特别设计的，非常美丽。

fragments.text: Children absolutely love it, but then, so do adults.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 孩子们非常喜欢，成年人也一样。

fragments.text: The
called Town and Country.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 主展厅叫做城市与乡村。

fragments.text: It includes a photographic collection of prizewinning sheep and shepherds. Leaving Town and Country, you enter Farmhouse Kitchen, which is ... well,

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 它包括了一个获奖的羊和牧羊人的摄影收藏。离开城市与乡村，你进入农家厨房，这是...不言自明的。

fragments.text: Here we have the oldest collection of

acceptedAnswers: equipment for making butter and cheese in the country

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 这里有国内最古老的制作黄油和奶酪设备收藏。

fragments.text: And this morning, a specialist cheesemaker will be
of how it's produced.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 今天早上，一位专业的奶酪制造商将会进行示范。

fragments.text: You may even get to try some.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 你甚至可以尝一些。

fragments.text: After that, you can go in

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 在那之后，你可以选择两个方向。

fragments.text: To the right is a staircase that takes you up to a landing from where you can

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 向右边是一条楼梯，可以带你上到一个平台，从那里你可以俯瞰展览馆。

fragments.text: To the left is a room called A Year on the Farm.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 向左边是一个叫做农场一年的房间。

fragments.text: There's lots of seating here as sometimes we use the room for school visits, so it's a

acceptedAnswers: good place to stop for a rest

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 这里有很多座位，因为有时候我们会用这个房间接待学校参观，所以这是一个休息的好地方。

fragments.text: If you're
you can take our memory test in which you answer questions about things you've seen in the museum.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 如果你有竞争心，你可以参加我们的记忆测试，回答关于你在博物馆看到的事物的问题。

fragments.text: The next area's called Wagon Walk. This contains farm carts from nearly every part of the country.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 接下来的区域叫做马车步行区。这里有来自全国各地的农用马车。

fragments.text: It's surprising how much
there was.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 令人惊讶的是，各地的差异非常大。

fragments.text: Beside the carts are
with information about each one.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 马车旁边有展板，上面有关于每个马车的信息。

fragments.text: The carts are old and fragile, so we ask you to keep your children close to you and

acceptedAnswers: ensure they don't climb on the carts

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 马车古老而脆弱，所以我们要求你们让孩子靠近你们，并确保他们不要爬上马车。

fragments.text: From Wagon Walk, you can either make your way
or go out into the garden – or even go back to take another look in the galleries.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 从马车步行区，你可以返回接待处，或者走出去到花园，甚至可以回去再看一下展览馆。

fragments.text: In the far corner of the garden is Bees are Magic, but we're redeveloping this area so you can't visit that

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 在花园的远角是一个叫做蜜蜂的魔法的地方，但我们正在重新开发这个区域，所以目前无法参观。

fragments.text: You can still
in the shop, though.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 不过你仍然可以在商店购买我们的蜂蜜。

fragments.text: Finally, there's The Pond, which contains

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 最后，有一个叫做池塘的地方，那里有各种有趣的野生动物。

fragments.text: There are baby ducks that are only
, as well as tiny frogs.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 有几天大的小鸭子，还有小青蛙。

fragments.text: The Pond isn't deep and there's a
around it, so it's perfectly safe for children.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 池塘不深，周围有围栏，所以对孩子来说是完全安全的。

title: 农业生活博物馆导览 (Museum of Farming Life tour)
